blocks.text: ABOUT COLDSTREAM EXTERIORS OF ST. LOUIS
Co-Owners and Founders of Coldstream Exteriors STL
Great companies are built on shared values, trust, and experience—and ours is no exception.

Founders Jon and Greg first crossed paths in the early 2000s. Jon had built a successful logistics company grounded in efficiency, accountability, and customer service. Greg brought leadership experience as a Director of Sales in the collectible antique automobile industry, where precision, transparency, and reputation are everything. What began as a professional introduction quickly developed into a strong friendship built on aligned values, sound business ethics, and a shared vision for how a company should operate.

With years of hands-on experience in home remodeling and exterior restoration, Jon and Greg recognized an opportunity to raise the standard in the exterior construction industry. They saw firsthand how homeowners were often left confused, underserved, or frustrated by unclear processes and inconsistent workmanship. That insight led to the launch of Coldstream Exteriors St. Louis.

Today, our company is built around the principles that guided its founding: honest communication, quality craftsmanship, and accountability at every stage of a project. We approach each home as if it were our own, focusing on long-term solutions—not shortcuts. Whether navigating storm restoration or planning a full exterior remodel, our team is committed to providing clear guidance, reliable timelines, and results our customers can trust.
We’re proud of the relationships we’ve built and the reputation we continue to earn—one project at a time. Thank you for considering us with one of your most important investments: your home.

With over 25 years of experience, the team at Coldstream Exteriors can handle all of your home’s exterior construction needs. From roofing and siding to windows and gutters, our team has you covered. We offer a wide range of services, catering all projects to fit the needs and budgets of our clients. We love working with individuals looking to enhance their home and pride ourselves on delivering results our clients are proud of.

We require no payments until project completion which takes away the risk of putting down a deposit and having a contractor not complete the work. Additionally, every Coldstream location is locally owned and operated and adhere to the highest quality and personnel standards in the industry.
